title: Domains G_{x,λ} = η_{x,λ}(B_2(0)): membership test ‖x + λv‖ < 2, openness, and B_2(0) ∪ closedBall 0 R ⊆ G_{x,λ} for admissible (x, λ) with λR ≤ 1 (parent steps 0(e), 4)
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, x ∈ ℝ^P (= Euclid P) and λ > 0, let η_{x,λ} := dilation x λ (so η_{x,λ}(u) = −λ⁻¹x + λ⁻¹u) and G := η_{x,λ}(B_2(0)), where B_2(0) is the open ball of radius 2 about 0. Then: (a) for every v ∈ ℝ^P, v ∈ G ⟺ ‖x + λ·v‖ < 2; (b) G is open; (c) if moreover λ ≤ 1 and ‖x‖ ≤ 1 − λ, then B_2(0) ⊆ G, and closedBall 0 R ⊆ G for every real R with λ·R ≤ 1.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (x : Euclid P) (lam : ℝ), 0 < lam → (∀ v : Euclid P, v ∈ dilation x lam '' ball 0 2 ↔ ‖x + lam • v‖ < 2) ∧ IsOpen (dilation x lam '' ball 0 2) ∧ (lam ≤ 1 → ‖x‖ ≤ 1 - lam → ball 0 2 ⊆ dilation x lam '' ball 0 2 ∧ ∀ R : ℝ, lam * R ≤ 1 → closedBall 0 R ⊆ dilation x lam '' ball 0 2)
